name: TC-862: Combo with a choose-from line — the choices are saved without pressing Done, shown in Edit, and one more choice saves
description: Create → Combo price: two fixed items, then a third item with "+ Add an option" and two more picked as its options — the line becomes a "Customer picks 1" group (Done is never pressed), Save for later (no deal slot). The server deal has a line whose options are exactly those three items. Edit shows that line with the same choices. Changing it to four choices (one more, via the line's "+ Add an option" button, Done again not pressed) and Save changes is a change, not "Nothing to save", and the server line now has all four.
